findings.problem: The hint wrongly says manera also means shape (it is forma that does), and it doesn't rule out modo or camino, both common answers for 'the way to do it'.
findings.fix: hint: manner, as in the way to do it; not manera or modo, but the word that also means shape

back.es: the form, shape; way, manner (feminine noun)
back.example: There is no other way to do it.

note: Pointing to the shape meaning in the hint is a good way to single out forma, because manera and modo don't share it.
